Standard: A special process control plan that ensures that material used in the air system design produced by special processes achieve their design performance for the duration of their design life exists for the air vehicle. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review documentation to confirm a special process control plan that meets the standard exists for the air vehicle.
(2) Review documentation to confirm special processes are defined and controlled IAW SAE AS9100.
